# katoptra.org

> Public mirrors of open-source software archives. Each mirror syncs from its
> upstream on a fixed schedule through an open pipeline, is verified against the
> upstream's own signatures and checksums where upstream signs its tree, and is
> served on Cloudflare's global network. Paths and bytes are unchanged from
> upstream, so a mirror here drops in wherever that archive's URL is accepted. Run
> by Josh Vaughen (https://ijosh.com).

## Mirrors

- CTAN: https://ctan.katoptra.org/ (upstream: https://ctan.org, refreshed hourly)
  Every CTAN path at the root. Point tlmgr at it:
  `tlmgr option repository https://ctan.katoptra.org/systems/texlive/tlnet/`
- TeX Live (tlnet): https://tlnet.katoptra.org/ (upstream: https://ctan.org/tex-archive/systems/texlive/tlnet, refreshed daily)
  The tlnet subtree alone, every platform. Point tlmgr at it:
  `tlmgr option repository https://tlnet.katoptra.org/systems/texlive/tlnet/`
- GNU: https://gnu.katoptra.org/ (upstream: https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/, refreshed twice daily)
  Every path of ftp.gnu.org/gnu at the root. Swap the host in any GNU download URL:
  `https://gnu.katoptra.org/emacs/`
- Savannah (nongnu): https://nongnu.katoptra.org/ (upstream: https://download.savannah.nongnu.org/releases/, refreshed twice daily)
  Savannah's nongnu release tree at the root: `https://nongnu.katoptra.org/freetype/`

To leave a TeX mirror: `tlmgr option repository ctan`.

## Private mirrors

Nightly copies of the owner's own Dropbox and GitHub accounts into Proton Drive, with
nothing public to fetch. Their pipelines are open source and can be forked to mirror
your own accounts: https://github.com/katoptra/dropbox and
https://github.com/katoptra/github

## Source

- Sync pipelines and site: https://github.com/katoptra
